summary: Use shared assistant error presentation for native stop outcomes

replay.detail: Native transcript outcomes remain normalized on owner reads; no replay trigger changes.

schema.detail: No database migration or stored transcript class changes.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Supersedes the push_omp_stop description in native-outcomes.json: assistant stops use main's existing assistant_error view, not separate system errors. Exact stopReason, errorMessage, errorStatus, errorId and retryRecovery fields are retained under view.native. Superseded attempts, silent aborts and user interrupts keep main's hidden presentation; length and unknown stops remain visible. Session exits retain the previously described cancelled status or fatal/unknown diagnostic errors. Existing timeline kinds and client schemas are unchanged. This applies directly from main or from earlier native-outcomes branch builds, with no intermediate migration required.

downtime.detail: No extra service interruption beyond normal binary restart.

manual.detail: No manual data or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: Preserve owner-local native transcripts; no additional recovery procedure.
